caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of fabric with frayed edges, featuring a central design bordered by a decorative frame. The dominant colors are red, black, and beige. The border consists of a repeated pattern of red leaves or fruit outlined in black against a beige background, with a solid black line separating the border from the central section. Inside the border, a large, irregularly shaped red area fills most of the middle. At the bottom center of the red area, there are two detailed black and red floral arrangements placed in baskets or vases, with visible stems and leaves. The background around the floral arrangements is beige, contrasting with the surrounding red area. The fabric shows signs of wear, with some edges rough and threads visible, and there is a faint signature "E. Capaldo" in the lower right corner.
title: Printed Textiles
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
